description: This file implements the RRefContext class and related functions for managing remote references (RRefs) in PyTorch's distributed RPC framework, including handling of RRef creation, deletion, forks, and error handling.

classes.name: RRefContext
classes.description: Manages remote references (RRefs) in distributed RPC, including creation, deletion, forking, and error handling.

classes.name: PendingUserState
classes.description: Represents the state of a pending user RRef during RPC operations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RRefContext.

methods.name: destroyInstance
methods.description: Destroys the singleton instance, optionally ignoring leaks.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions in JitFuture, aborting on error.

methods.name: getDebugInfo
methods.description: Returns debug information about RRef leaks and counts.

methods.name: checkRRefLeaks
methods.description: Checks for RRef leaks during shutdown, optionally failing the process.

methods.name: createUserRRef
methods.description: Creates a new UserRRef for remote usage.

methods.name: delUser
methods.description: Deletes a user RRef on the owner side.

methods.name: delAllUsersAndUnforkedOwners
methods.description: Deletes all user RRefs and unforked owner RRefs during shutdown.

methods.name: getOrCreateRRef
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an RRef based on fork data.

methods.name: getOrCreateOwnerRRef
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an owner RRef.

methods.name: createOwnerRRef
methods.description: Creates a new owner RRef without adding it to the owners map.

methods.name: getOwnerRRef
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a future for an owner RRef.

methods.name: prepareChildFork
methods.description: Prepares a fork of an RRef for remote transfer.

methods.name: notifyOwnerAndParentOfFork
methods.description: Notifies owner and parent about a fork of an RRef.

methods.name: addSelfAsFork
methods.description: Adds the current RRef as a fork to the context.

methods.name: addForkOfOwner
methods.description: Records a fork of an owner RRef.

methods.name: addForkOfOwnerIfNotPresent
methods.description: Adds a fork of an owner RRef if not already present.

methods.name: delForkOfOwner
methods.description: Deletes a fork of an owner RRef, possibly removing the owner RRef.
